task: W4-C3 — CANONICAL PENDING MODIFICATION REQUEST AUTHORITY

scope.slice: W4-C3: CANONICAL PENDING MODIFICATION REQUEST AUTHORITY ONLY
scope.historicalIntentContract: Durable internal pending request binding active reservation effective version to accepted-offer target quote

migration.strategy: Additive schema extension creating canonical_reservation_modification_requests table with composite foreign keys to W4-C1 sealed revisions and stays_quotes; atomic routine canonical_request_reservation_modification with authorization-before-replay order, PRESENT W1 commercial source-currentness check, wall-clock expiry check post-row-lock, deterministic command fingerprinting, and restricted execution role encho_modification_issuer

columns.reservation_id: UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES canonical_reservations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
columns.holder_principal: TEXT NOT NULL (validated via routine input validation ^(user:[0-9]+|session:[0-9a-f-]{36})$ and foreign key/holder equality with canonical_reservations.holder_principal; table schema defines NOT NULL without inline CHECK regex)
columns.target_quote_id: UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES stays_quotes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

tableSchema.shapeConstraint: chk_modification_request_source_version_shape CHECK ((source_effective_version = 1 AND source_revision_id IS NULL) OR (source_effective_version >= 2 AND source_revision_id IS NOT NULL))
tableSchema.compositeRevisionFk: fk_modification_request_source_revision FOREIGN KEY (source_revision_id, reservation_id, source_effective_version) REFERENCES canonical_reservation_revisions(id, reservation_id, version) ON DELETE RESTRICT
tableSchema.sealFk: fk_modification_request_source_sealed FOREIGN KEY (source_revision_id) REFERENCES canonical_reservation_revision_seals(revision_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
tableSchema.immutability: Trigger canonical_reservation_modification_requests_immutable executes canonical_reservation_modification_requests_prevent_mutation() which raises CANONICAL_MODIFICATION_REQUEST_IMMUTABLE on UPDATE or DELETE
tableSchema.rowLevelSecurity: Enabled and forced: ALTER TABLE canonical_reservation_modification_requests ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE canonical_reservation_modification_requests FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

functionSignature.name: canonical_request_reservation_modification
functionSignature.returns: TABLE (request_id UUID, reservation_id UUID, command_id UUID, holder_principal TEXT, source_effective_version INT, source_revision_id UUID, target_quote_id UUID, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, replayed BOOLEAN)
functionSignature.security: VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp SET row_security = on
functionSignature.roleModel: REVOKE ALL FROM PUBLIC and all runtime roles; conditional GRANT EXECUTE to encho_modification_issuer when role exists with strictly pre-validated restricted privileges (no table DML, no schema create, no bypassrls, no superuser)
functionSignature.roleProvisioningNote: Role encho_modification_issuer must be provisioned before migration/application in the intended environment; migration skips grant if role does not exist; disposable tests provision it explicitly.

architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step1_inputValidation: Rejects NULLs, malformed principals (^(user:[0-9]+|session:[0-9a-f-]{36})$), source version < 1
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step2_reservationLock: SELECT * FROM canonical_reservations WHERE id = target_reservation_id FOR UPDATE
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step5_fingerprintComputation: Deterministic SHA-256 over canonical JSONB payload (command_type, reservation_id, authenticated_principal, expected_source_effective_version, target_quote_id)
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step6_replayCheck: Authorization-before-replay order: verifies existing command_id under locked reservation; if fingerprint matches, returns stored result with replayed = true BEFORE mutable gates; if fingerprint differs, raises MODIFICATION_COMMAND_CONFLICT
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step9_mutableGateTargetQuote: stays_quotes must exist, quote_kind = 'ACCEPTED_OFFER', matching holder principal, matching listing_id
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step10_mutableGateOfferPointer: Locks sellable_offers FOR UPDATE; verifies quote_row.offer_revision matches offer_ptr.current_accepted_revision and public_disposition = 'ACCEPTED'; checks static listing/room coherence, date window, occupancy, currency, and arithmetic
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step11_mutableGatePresentSourceFacts: Recomputes PRESENT W1 source snapshot via public.sellable_offer_source_snapshot(listing_id, room_type_id); recomputes current_source_hash and current_media_hash; checks against offer_rev_row and verifies approved media URLs are safe; raises MODIFICATION_OFFER_SOURCE_STALE on mismatch or unsafe URL (live inventory check: NONE)
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step12_mutableGateWallClockExpiry: Checks stays_quotes.expires_at <= clock_timestamp() strictly AFTER acquiring reservation and offer row locks
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step13_atomicInsertion: Inserts row into canonical_reservation_modification_requests; catches EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN queries existing row by command_id, verifies matching parameters/fingerprint for idempotent replay return or raises MODIFICATION_COMMAND_CONFLICT on divergence

frozenRequirementCoverage.testEvidence: Case A: ACTIVE Encho Direct V1 + fresh quote + matching holder: succeeds, persists row, zero inventory mutation, zero target holds, zero revisions
Case B: Sealed V2 source captures exact revision; unsealed V3 ignored: resolves exact source_revision_id FK
Case C: Stale expected source version rejected: expected version != effective_version raises MODIFICATION_SOURCE_VERSION_MISMATCH
Case D: CANCELLATION_REQUESTED lifecycle rejected: raises MODIFICATION_LIFECYCLE_CONFLICT
Case E: CANCELLED lifecycle rejected: raises MODIFICATION_LIFECYCLE_CONFLICT
Case F: Quote expired rejected: wall-clock expiry raises MODIFICATION_QUOTE_EXPIRED
Case G: Quote expiry DURING LOCK WAIT evaluated with post-wait wall clock: evaluates clock_timestamp() post-lock and raises MODIFICATION_QUOTE_EXPIRED
Case H: Reservation / quote holder mismatch rejected: authenticated principal !== reservation/quote holder raises MODIFICATION_AUTHORIZATION_DENIED / MODIFICATION_QUOTE_HOLDER_MISMATCH
Case I: Foreign authenticated principal rejected for create & replay: foreign principal trying to replay existing command raises MODIFICATION_AUTHORIZATION_DENIED without leaking stored request
Case J: Quote kind != ACCEPTED_OFFER rejected: non-accepted quote raises MODIFICATION_QUOTE_KIND_INVALID
Case K: Different listing target quote rejected: target quote listing !== reservation listing raises MODIFICATION_LISTING_MISMATCH
Case L: Quote / offer static incoherence rejected: corrupted quote amount, dates, or guests mismatching offer raises MODIFICATION_QUOTE_INCOHERENT
Case M: Superseded offer revision rejected: target quote pointing to historical revision when current_accepted_revision was superseded raises MODIFICATION_OFFER_SUPERSEDED

Case AD: Stale W1 source facts rejected for NEW modification request: mutated room_types.name causes W1 to report OFFER_STALE_REVIEW and NEW C3 command raises MODIFICATION_OFFER_SOURCE_STALE; zero rows inserted
Case AF: Same-listing different-room positive case: target quote on different room within same listing succeeds cleanly; zero inventory/holds/revisions
Case O: Exact idempotent replay returns same stored result: returns replayed = true with identical request_id and created_at
Case P: Replay after quote expiry succeeds without re-evaluating expiry: replayed = true before mutable gates
Case Q: Replay after offer succession succeeds without re-evaluating: replayed = true before mutable gates
Case AE: Replay after source drift succeeds without re-evaluating source currentness: returns replayed = true for pre-drift command
Case R: Replay after lifecycle change succeeds without re-evaluating: cancelled reservation returns replayed = true
Case S: Same command + changed target quote -> conflict: raises MODIFICATION_COMMAND_CONFLICT
Case T: Same command + changed expected source version -> conflict: raises MODIFICATION_COMMAND_CONFLICT
Case U: Same command + changed principal -> rejected without disclosure: raises MODIFICATION_AUTHORIZATION_DENIED
Case V: Same command + changed reservation -> rejected: raises MODIFICATION_AUTHORIZATION_DENIED
Case W: Same-command two-connection race creates exactly 1 row: concurrent identical commands serialize cleanly via unique_violation exception handling and idempotent return
Case X: Distinct-command same-source requests are both allowed: two separate commands on same reservation both succeed and persist distinct rows
Case AB & Case Y: Table trigger rejects UPDATE and DELETE with CANONICAL_MODIFICATION_REQUEST_IMMUTABLE; structural check constraint chk_modification_request_source_version_shape enforces shape
Case AB: Role isolation & immutability enforcement: unprivileged roles denied EXECUTE on routine; issuer restricted from table DML and non-routine tables
Case Z: No-op quote succeeds with zero side effects: quote with identical dates/room succeeds with zero side effects
Case AA: Write-set containment: only request table modified; zero changes to inventory_days, booking_holds, canonical_reservations, canonical_reservation_revisions, etc.
Case AC: Zero public ingress route / runtime caller evidence: committed diff touches ONLY 3 files with zero routes/controllers, git grep finds zero runtime callers
Case AC: Zero modification writer in pg_proc: no routine capable of publishing revisions exists in database
